user.title: Connect to the Pylontech serial bridge
user.description: Enter the ESPHome device running the serial_proxy bridge. The encryption key is the API `key` from your ESPHome secrets.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the ESP (e.g. 192.168.186.98)
data_description.proxy_name: The `name:` of the serial_proxy in the ESPHome config

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect, or the serial port name was not found on that device.

data_description.cell_sensors: Adds a voltage sensor for every cell, plus a weakest-cell and balancing sensor per battery. Sends one extra 'bat N' command per battery each poll.
data_description.sync_time: Sets the battery's real-time clock to Home Assistant's time on every connect. Only affects future log timestamps.

get_log.name: Get log
get_log.description: Reads recent records from the battery's on-device event or history log.

source.name: Source
source.description: Which log to read: 'event' (faults/state changes) or 'history' (periodic samples).

count.name: Count
count.description: How many recent records to return (1-50).

config_entry_id.name: Config entry
config_entry_id.description: Which Pylontech stack to query (only needed if more than one is configured).

set_time.name: Set battery clock
set_time.description: Sets the battery's real-time clock. Only affects future log timestamps.

datetime.name: Date and time
datetime.description: Time to set. Defaults to Home Assistant's current time.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry
config_entry_id.description: Which Pylontech stack to set (only needed if more than one is configured).
